correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation produces the degree-eight G with G(0)=1 and G(1)<0. Under the bijection y=z/(1-z), H(y) has c0,c1,c2>0 and c7,c8<0. Exact inequalities c4<5c3, 5c5<7c4 and 7c6<5c5 force at most one coefficient sign change. Descartes then gives exactly one positive zero counted with multiplicity; existence follows by IVT. Positive power-series summands force no critical point at or before 1/3. Simplicity gives strict maximum and analytic parameter dependence. Independently checked symbolic identities match all displayed coefficients; finite samples are supplementary only.
